content:
What the file is, what goes in it, and why most sites are missing it.

In this issue

  • What Goes in an llms.txt. The format is simple. A text file at the root of the site.
  • The Allow vs Block Decision. There's a deliberate choice available in robots.txt.
  • What This Looks Like In Practice. An audit of four ecommerce sites turned up every possible state.
  • Most Operators Don't Know About Either File. In conversations with ecommerce operators. Platform teams, agency owners, brand managers.
  • What an AI Audit Misses. The three failing sites took about an hour each to fix.
  • Check Your Own Sites. Open a new tab. Type a domain followed by /llms.txt.
